hero.description: Văn Cô Nhung's tutoring class takes students from grade 5 to grade 11. Closely follows the school curriculum, builds structured paragraph and essay writing skills, and helps your child grow more confident in Literature every day.

grades.title: A learning path suited to every grade
grades.description: Each grade has its own curriculum, closely following the textbook and exam requirements for that level.

items.title: Grade 5
items.desc: Builds paragraph-writing fundamentals and introduces literary appreciation ahead of secondary school.

items.title: Grade 6
items.desc: Introduces the secondary curriculum, building reading comprehension and full essay-writing skills.

items.title: Grade 7
items.desc: Reinforces Vietnamese language fundamentals and sharpens argumentative and expressive writing.

items.title: Grade 8
items.desc: Practices social and literary argumentative essays following a standard structure.

items.title: Grade 9
items.desc: Focuses on high school entrance exam prep, with practice tests matching the real exam format.

items.title: Grade 10
items.desc: Introduces the high school curriculum and sharpens literary analysis skills.

items.title: Grade 11
items.desc: Builds a solid foundation, preparing early for the high school graduation exam.

items.title: Custom support classes
items.desc: 1-on-1 or small-group tutoring tailored to your needs, with flexible timing and pace.

plans.name: Grade 8 - Grade 9
plans.desc: 2 sessions/week · 90 minutes/session · Grade 10 entrance exam prep available
features: Social and literary argumentative essay practice
Practice tests matching the exam format

plans.name: Grade 10 - Grade 11
features: Builds a foundation for the graduation exam
